template: Close-up portrait of a cute felted wool {species} toy mascot, the head fills most of the frame, front view. The surface is smooth, dense, matte {color} wool felt like a wet-felted Waldorf toy: tightly packed and even, with a very short light fuzz and a crisp clean outline, no loops, no yarn, no stitches, no knit pattern. Simple glossy black bead eyes. {prop} Any prop is a real, realistic object, not felt. Soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, {background}, no text, no logo.

roster.prop: It wears a large real polished gold Spartan helmet with a tall red crest, lit by warm orange ember rim light that glows along the edge of the felt.
roster.background: dark charcoal background with a golden aura and a warm orange ember glow behind the head
